text:
ITEM 1 | Leafy green mound of dark green, ruffled, peppery-looking leaves with thin pale stems, mixed with thin orange shredded strips (carrot-like) and a few pale white-edged slices (radish-like) on the plate's left side, lightly glossy from dressing, about 13 cm by 11 cm footprint, mounded roughly 3 cm high | 95
ITEM 2 | Sliced meat in three overlapping pieces, brown-to-reddish-grey with darker seared edges, slightly glossy and moist surface, speckled with small red flakes and green herb bits, each slice about 6 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, sitting in the center-right of the plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Diced pale tan cubes with golden-brown crusty faces, firm and slightly crisp edges, about 1.5 cm cubes, mixed with a loose scatter of crumbly grains, shredded orange strips, and small pale white pieces, sitting at the lower right of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Scattered small bits of greenish-grey herb garnish and a light sheen of dressing on the greens, thin film, barely visible, next to the salad | 5
